Alex and Anita from Wisq, along with Ken from GE Appliances, discussed Wisq's data security and AI practices for GDPR compliance, clarifying several points in the questionnaire and confirming Wisq's adherence to data protection standards. 3. Ken's Role: Ken leads HR technology across GE's umbrella of companies, located in the US.
4. Questionnaire Clarification: Alex and Anita are reviewing an assessment questionnaire and need Ken's help to clarify specific questions.
5. Solution Owner Identified: Ken provides Gaetano Mascola as the solution owner for the system in question.

Workday is our deepest HCM integration. We currently have Workday customers
using Wisq to streamline performance reviews and OKR workflows, and to
automate high-volume HR transactions directly through Workday.

Harper connects directly to Workday to securely *read data* and *initiate
actions* on behalf of employees, while fully honoring your existing
security, permissions, and approval workflows.

Importantly, Harper doesn’t just surface a form for someone to complete—she
provides *real-time guidance* to ensure requests are correct and aligned
with policy before they ever reach HR. For example, in job or promotion
changes, Harper can help a manager determine whether the request fits
compensation guidelines, role architecture, or exception criteria, reducing
the back-and-forth
